nodes.name: app-shell-tauri spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for the Tauri 2 application shell: SvelteKit static SPA frontend, preserved event vocabulary, plugin-backed platform services, image previews, and mobile (Android + iOS) targets.

nodes.name: app-shell spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for the unified responsive shell: one shell tree across platforms and widths, platform-adaptive header chrome, a collapsible icon-rail sidebar, no in-app back, and safe-area handling.

nodes.name: code-phrase-share spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for human code-phrase quick sharing: generated/typed codes, PAKE-authenticated ticket exchange, NodeId binding against rendezvous MITM, and no device-trust side effects.

nodes.name: device-management spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for the device-management UI: a dedicated Devices page, a symmetric add-a-device flow, one-tap confirmation, local device rename, and links from the send flow into pairing.

nodes.name: device-pairing spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for trusted device pairing: per-device Ed25519 identity, fingerprints, trust store, ECDH shared secret, SAS, signed offers/responses/completions, short-code pairing, and glare resolution.

nodes.name: download-destination spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for received-file destinations: user-visible location per platform, one flat time-sortable layout, no code-phrase folder names, collision avoidance, path sanitization, and permission-free Android writes.

nodes.name: mobile-navigation spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for mobile navigation: the sidebar rendered as a left drawer with hamburger open, navigate-to-collapse, one-handed dismissal, and hardware-back handling.

nodes.name: receive-clipboard-detect spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for clipboard detection on the Receive tab: checking the clipboard on focus, auto-filling detected croc codes without overwriting typed input, showing provenance and clear controls, and suppressing auto-fill when appropriate.

nodes.name: rendezvous-broker spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for the Go rendezvous broker: device registration with proof of ownership, fingerprint signal routing, unreachable notices, one live connection per fingerprint, stateless operation, WebSocket keepalive/eviction, and the code-mailbox mode.

nodes.name: test-broker-harness spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for a single shared mock broker in the Rust test suite, unifying the mailbox and fingerprint-router mocks so no duplicated broker mocks remain and the test gate stays green.

nodes.name: transfer-delivery spec.md
nodes.summary: Current spec for transfer delivery semantics: a single active transfer session (send XOR receive), passive send completing on receiver acknowledgement, and send-slot expiry when stuck or unaccepted.
